items.name: Vine Rune

items.name: Hunter Data
items.description: Collect Hunter Data from 3 red Hunter Nests in the overlay. Reveals NeoVend's plan.

items.name: Spoke Climber
items.description: Climb The Free Spoke to access The Hub and AE1 Mainframe. (Also required for Bliss.)

items.name: Find the Nest
items.description: Locate the Core Nest inside The Warrens and slot the Imprinted Shipmind.

categories.name: Bliss the Ship Mechanic — Ship Mechanic

items.name: Partner with Bliss
items.description: Pay 100 Cryo to start a repair business with Bliss (earns Bay View achievement)

items.name: Help Bliss Compete
items.description: Complete Bliss's three ship repair contracts

items.name: Refit the Ambergris
items.description: Complete the final major refit (point of no return)

items.name: Sealing the Leak (Ember's Wake)
items.description: First repair contract — fix Ember's Wake. Timed.

items.name: Saving the Crop (Sycamore Seed)
items.description: Second repair contract. Rewards 2 Girolle Caps. A cycle wait separates each job.

items.name: Rigged and Ready (Starward Vector)
items.description: Third repair contract. Rewards 300 Cryo. Refitting Amber unlocks after this.

items.name: Refitting Amber
items.description: POINT OF NO RETURN: Final refit of the Ambergris. Completing it triggers the ending choice (Leave or Stay). Do NOT start if pursuing NeoVend endings too.

items.name: Killer is Dead / Catch the Killer
items.description: NeoVend path: After this clock, receive the Greenway Gate Key. Do NOT use it if pursuing Bliss endings.

items.name: Flotilla Aid
items.description: Gather food, water, and scrap to fill the Climbing Briar's hold for the flotilla run

items.name: Breaking Quarantine
items.description: Help Peake scope and execute a safe path through the Havenage cordon

items.name: Eshe's Run
items.description: COUNTDOWN: 12 cycles until Eshe makes her supply run. Better preparation = better outcome.

items.name: Briar's Hold
items.description: Fill the ship's hold: food from Algae Stack, water from Reservoir S3, scrap components.

items.name: Peake's Plan
items.description: Enact all 3 aspects of Peake's plan to create a blind spot in Havenage detection.

items.name: Havenage Suspicion
items.description: DANGER: If filled, triggers Cordon Sweep — 2 cycles where no progress can be made on Peake's Plan.

items.name: Grow Vast and Strange
items.description: Cut the thread when talking with Gardener (via Riko's questline). Break free and join the Data Cloud chorus.

items.name: Warmth and Light
items.description: Don't cut the thread — follow it back to Riko. Credits roll but you continue playing.

items.name: A Long Journey to a Small Unknown Planet
items.description: Leave the Eye together aboard the Sidereal Horizon with Lem and Mina.

items.name: Left Behind
items.description: Let Lem and Mina leave on the Sidereal Horizon, but stay at the Eye yourself.

items.name: The Three Body Problem
items.description: Destroy the Celis IDs. No one boards the Sidereal — all three watch it depart.

items.name: Solo Ticket
items.description: Never babysit Mina. Steal Celis data for Castor and leave the Eye alone.

items.name: Starward Passage
items.description: Complete Refitting Amber and choose "I'm going." Leave Erlin's Eye with Bliss and Ankhita.

items.name: The Fixed Stars
items.description: Complete Refitting Amber and choose "I'm staying." Remain at Erlin's Eye with Moritz.

items.name: The Bad End
items.description: A specific outcome from Ankhita's questline if you accept payment after the final encounter.

items.name: Citizen Sleeper
items.description: Decline to leave via any offered ending. Simply exist on the Eye with nothing left to do.

items.name: Nether Kraken
items.description: Scripted intro — survive the arm slams, Kraken retreats when ship crashes.

items.name: Hulk Trooper
items.description: Mini-boss on the shore before reaching Ossex City.

items.name: Thorne (Round 1)
items.description: First proper boss after the shipwreck.

items.name: The Duchess of Queensbury
items.description: Gate boss for the first Spark Generator.

items.name: Nox's Beast
items.description: Gate boss for the Swampy Generator.

items.name: Madd House
items.description: Gate boss — clears the path to Septemburg.

items.name: Mined Mind
items.description: Gate boss for the Shoreline Generator.

items.name: Orrery Warden
items.description: Gate boss for the Astral Generator.

items.name: Frozen Horror
items.description: Gate boss for the Coltrane Generator.

items.name: Thorne (Round 2)
items.description: Thorne returns.

items.name: Thorne (Round 3)
items.description: Final confrontation.

items.name: Midden
items.description: Enter through the door requiring 2 Plasma Vials, then insult him to trigger the fight.

items.name: Thalassion
items.description: Catch all 15 fish using the fishing rod from Irwin & Durwin, then cross the watery area to the right.

items.name: Dark Deluxy
items.description: Specific trigger required — consult a guide.

items.name: Mirren
items.description: Dig under the ice from the Underlab.

items.name: Armand
items.description: One of five Renegades. Defeat all five for the Renegade Roundup reward.

items.name: Maxi
items.description: Renegade.

items.name: Willis
items.description: Renegade.

items.name: Dugin
items.description: Renegade.

items.name: Evra the Undying
items.description: Renegade — hardest secret boss. Rides an undead steed. Requires multiple movement abilities to reach.

items.name: Poppit Stop #1
items.description: Reward: Wisp Trinket

items.name: Poppit Stop #2
items.description: Reward: Wisp Trinket

items.name: Poppit Stop #3
items.description: Reward: Wisp Trinket

items.name: Fishing (all 15 catches)
items.description: Reward: Unlocks Thalassion boss

items.name: Choppe Shoppe Challenge
items.description: Reward: Chain Capacitor Trinket

items.name: Music Hall Sequence
items.description: Reward: Pneumatic Armlet Trinket

items.name: Southern Outskirts Duo
items.description: Reward: Lace Glove Trinket

items.name: Renegade Roundup (all 5)
items.description: Reward: Trinket Bag + Spark Container + Health Rose + Gilded Rod

items.name: Iron Steed Donation (10,000 Bones)
items.description: Reward: Unlocks Coltrane Peak access
